rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when citizenship means the country a person legally belongs to.
Use this when you want to state explicitly that citizenship is a person's legal status as a citizen.

example.english: The application form must include your citizenship.
example.traditional: 申請表上必須填寫你的公民身份。
